integrity: The monotonicity and trichotomy follow by direct differentiation and asymptotic analysis of the published endemic-equilibrium equation. The bundled numerical checker is corroborative rather than a substitute for the analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns the endemic equilibrium of the reduced \(\tau=0\) SIRM system for \(\mathcal R_0>1\). It does not assert equilibrium stability for every parameter value, finite-delay persistence of the law, or biological attainability of arbitrarily large \(a/b\).
title: Sharp information-turnover trichotomy for endemic prevalence
